key.name: accent-color
key.description: A palette id from lib/colors.js, or 'custom' to use custom-color, or 'system' to leave the GNOME accent color untouched.

key.name: custom-color
key.description: Hex color used when accent-color is 'custom'.

key.name: apply-to-folders
key.description: Writes accent-tinted copies of the folder icons into ~/.local/share/icons, shadowing the system icon theme.

key.name: sync-system-accent
key.description: Sets org.gnome.desktop.interface accent-color to the nearest of GNOME's nine built-in accents. Apps that read the accent programmatically rather than from CSS - and Flatpak apps, which cannot see our gtk.css - only ever see that enum, so this keeps them approximately in step. The original value is restored when the extension is disabled.

key.name: saved-system-accent
key.summary: The user's accent-color before we changed it
key.description: Internal. Empty when we have not overridden it.

key.name: applied-system-accent
key.summary: The system accent value written by this extension
key.description: Internal. Used to avoid overwriting a newer accent choice when restoring saved-system-accent.

key.name: force-important
key.description: Marks generated shell declarations !important so they win against the base theme regardless of stylesheet cascade order.
